subject: Data TTL options & evidence — MedAugment follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@medaugment.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps on TTL / PII handling

Hi Rajiv — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Customer ask: MedAugment needs a short-term retention carve-out for non-PII session telemetry (7 days) and absolute zero-retention for any field containing direct identifiers (SSN, MRN, unredacted PHI).
- Residency: production inference must live in us-west region (data residency confirmed).
- Audit evidence: legal asked for SOC 2 scope evidence + KMS/HSM integration note.
- Runtime behavior: you want the KV-cache to be configurable per-route (so frontend chat can be ephemeral while batch job caches can be 7d).

Attachments: I’ll send a short DLP checklist and a table comparing options (0d / 7d / 30d) with product implications.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll attach the Proposed_TTL_Table.pdf and MedAugment_DLP_Checklist.xlsx (how we map data classes to retention).
2) If that looks ok, we’ll scope a one-week pilot for the 7-day non-PII window, during which Redwood will enable: route-level TTL, prefix KV purge, and audit logging to a customer-supplied S3 (if requested).
3) Schedule legal/ops call with Dana to review SOC 2 evidence and contract redlines.

Can you confirm: is the absolute zero-retention requirement for identifiers a hard requirement for the pilot, or something your legal team would like to see in the contract once pilot proves behavior?

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0122
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Proposal: Proposed_TTL_Table.pdf (PDF, 42KB); DLP checklist: MedAugment_DLP_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@medaugment.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Hughes <dana@medaugment.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@medaugment.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps on TTL / PII handling

Marissa — great write-up, thanks. Confirming a few things from our side: 

- Zero-retention for direct identifiers is a must for production. That means any field we mark as PII must never be stored in persistent logs or long-lived KV. Ephemeral in-memory caches are OK during inference as long as they’re purged immediately afterward and not persisted.
- For non-PII telemetry we’re OK with a 7-day TTL during the pilot to validate accuracy and metrics.
- Residency: yes, us-west only.
- Evidence: Dana will drive legal review; she asked if you can provide the SOC 2 Type II report redacted (or presigned NDA copy) and a short note on KMS support and audit log granularity.

Two quick asks: can the Proposed_TTL_Table include an explicit column showing which retention behaviors require a config change vs. which are standard product flags? And can you call out whether any of the behaviors need a Dedicated or Private deployment vs. Hosted?

Happy to schedule Dana + our infra lead for a 30-min sync — Dana, any preference for Thurs or Fri afternoon?

—Rajiv

On Mon, Aug 23, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Rajiv — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@medaugment.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps on TTL / PII handling

Thanks Rajiv — joining answers inline and attached an updated table.

- SOC2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report to your legal team under NDA. I’ll include a short note on what’s in scope and what isn’t.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS via our Private deployment and integrates with cloud KMS for Hosted; I called out both paths in the attached PDF.
- Proposed_TTL_Table.pdf now has the column you asked for (config vs. product-flag) and a deployment-impact column. Short summary: 0-retention for PII is supported on Hosted via route-level redaction hooks and Auditable Purge APIs; Dedicated/Private are required only if you want customer-side key escrow or on-prem storage of audit logs.

Pilot suggestion: enable 7d non-PII for 4 weeks, with a single config flag per route and automated daily purge of KV prefixes marked "pilot_nonpii". If pilot proves stable, contract will include the zero-retention clause for PII fields and team will sign off on audit evidence.

Next steps: I’ll circulate the two attachments to Dana and her team and propose Fri 8/27 2:30pm PT for the legal sync (I can do 2:30–3:00).

—Marissa

Attachments: Proposed_TTL_Table_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: quick approval for 7d concession + evidence pack to MedAugment (DEAL-2026-1137-MA)

Karthik / Neha — quick internal: Rajiv confirmed zero-retention for identifiers is mandatory, but they want a 7-day TTL for non-PII telemetry during pilot. I’ve outlined product impacts in the attached TTL table. Ask: approve the 7-day concession for pilot so we can move to contract & legal review.

Key points for approval:
- 7d non-PII: implemented as a route-level flag + daily automated purge. No Dedicated or Private required for pilot; Hosted supports it with our standard audit logs.
- Contract: if pilot completes, customer expects zero-retention clause for PII in contract + SOC 2 evidence. We should plan for a contract-level SLA exception for data retention enforcement and include a 30-day remediation timeline for any discrepancy.
- Commercials: recommend a pilot credit of $5k and a 3% concession if we need to include explicit retention SLAs in the first-year contract.

If you’re good, I’ll send the updated attachments to Dana and propose Fri legal sync.

—Marissa

On internal note: attaching Proposed_TTL_Table_v2.pdf (see redlines) and MedAugment_DLP_Checklist.xlsx.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-23T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: quick approval for 7d concession + evidence pack to MedAugment (DEAL-2026-1137-MA)

Approved.

Notes:
- OK to proceed with 7d for non-PII during pilot.
- Approve proposed pilot credit $5k.
- On the 3% concession tied to contract-level retention SLA: hold that as negotiable. Only commit if legal redlines tie us to measurable penalties.

Marissa — send Dana the SOC 2 redacted and TTL table; loop me if their legal asks any commercial changes.

—Karthik

Also please confirm whether the SOC 2 redacted report can be delivered under NDA prior to the call.

If we get agreement on the pilot scope in that call, MedAugment will expect a short SOW for the 7d pilot and a timeline for evidence delivery (SOC2 + KMS note) within 5 business days of signing.

—Rajiv
